title: Merchant Vessel Wreckage
description: Splintered planks and torn sailcloth litter the shallows where a merchant vessel broke apart. Crates bob in the knee-deep water, their contents spilling out with each wave. The wreck is fresh enough that gulls still circle overhead.

choices.label: Gather the timber
choices.description: Plenty of serviceable wood floats within easy reach.

choices.label: Search for valuables
choices.description: A merchant ship means merchant coin, scattered among the debris.

choices.label: Collect the rope and sinew
choices.description: Kelp-woven rigging makes excellent binding material.

choices.label: Leave the wreckage
choices.description: The tide is rising and the footing is treacherous.
